title: My School Day
text: Hi! My name is Ben. I go to school every day. My classroom is big and clean. My teacher's name is Ms. Lee. She is very kind. Every morning, I read a book before class starts. After lunch, I play with my friends on the playground. At night, I do my homework at my desk. I love my school!

questions.question: What is Ben's teacher's name?
questions.source_sentence: My teacher's name is Ms. Lee.

questions.question: Where does Ben play with his friends?
questions.source_sentence: After lunch, I play with my friends on the playground.

questions.question: When does Ben do his homework?
questions.source_sentence: At night, I do my homework at my desk.
